commands.name: gate
commands.description: Run the forge phase's Verifiable gate (/gate status, /gate <n> to pin a phase, /gate auto)
commands.output: forge-gate: no forge phase here. Check out a phase branch named in wiki/plan.md, or pin one with /gate <n>.

script:
$.process.run(/bin/sh -c idx=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" "$idx"…) → exit 0
tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

$.process.run(/bin/sh -c idx=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" "$idx"…) → exit 0

$.process.run(/bin/sh -c idx=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" "$idx"…) → exit 0
/gate → forge-gate: no forge phase here. Check out a phase branch named in wiki/plan.md,…

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: forge-gate.phase, forge-gate.runs, forge-gate.checked, forge-gate.tree, forge-gate.isRunning
./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=gate}, tool.call, turn.complete, classic.Stop, classic.SubagentStop, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}

./register.tsx calls: $.clock.now, $.command.register, $.fs.read (via readPlan), $.fs.stat (via planCommands), $.process.run (via isRunnable, locate, rootOf, runGate, treeId), $.session.cwd (via sessionDir), $.state.get, $.state.set, $.store.get (via adopt, refresh, runsFor), $.store.set (via markChecked, recordRuns), $.ui.ask (via runGate), $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast (via announce)
./register.tsx state writes: forge-gate.checked, forge-gate.isRunning, forge-gate.phase, forge-gate.runs, forge-gate.tree
./register.tsx state reads: forge-gate.checked, forge-gate.isRunning, forge-gate.phase, forge-gate.runs, forge-gate.tree
